title: E-FND-0070: the seven octonion imaginary units are the seven nonzero three-bit strings and all seven Fano lines are...
purpose: Experiment E-FND-0070 in the foundations arena: the seven octonion imaginary units are the seven nonzero three-bit strings and all seven Fano lines are exclusive-or triples (eight units, sixty-four products), the same binary combinatorics the I Ching encodes as eight trigrams and sixty-four hexagrams, while a random labeling breaks it.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
